purpose: A labelled section of a Sidebar: a SidebarGroupLabel over a menu of rows, with Size cascading to every row. Not for standalone use.

notFor.case: Used on its own, outside a Sidebar.
A group of items in a floating menu.

Collapsed=true.visual: The label is hidden; the rows are icon squares.

a11y.keyboard: None of its own: Tab moves through its rows.

openQuestions: Motion: the Collapsed axis has no motion decision (finding MOT-002). Should the label fade when the rail folds?
